item.title: Prompt Chaining: Make AI Check Its Own Work and Double Accuracy
item.description: Writing requires revision, and so do AI responses. Learn how to use prompt chaining to make Claude self-review and improve, dramatically boosting response accuracy. Like having AI write a draft, check it, polish it, and hand you a perfect final answer.
